title: COMP Render Page
summary: Official Derivative common COMP Render page reference for material assignment, Render TOP visibility, render flag interaction, draw and pick priority, wireframe color, and light masks on renderable components.
guidance: Use this article when a component is present but a render still misses geometry, material, draw-order, pick, or light-mask behavior.
The render parameter and the component Render Flag form a logical AND; both must allow rendering for component geometry to be visible in a Render TOP.
Use drawpriority to influence draw order among comparable components, especially transparent objects; smaller values draw after larger values.
Use pickpriority only for Render Pick CHOP/DAT search-area selection; it does not change draw order or per-pixel visibility.
A light must be listed both in the Render TOP and in the component lightmask when a mask is used.
